grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count=13014 with duplicate_row_rate=0.0, and observed_hour_utc has distinct_count=4341 across the 3 distinct airport_code values (EWR, JFK, LGA), which multiplies to roughly 13014 rows; this indicates one source row per airport per observed hour, so each row is already a discrete weather-observation event rather than a rolled-up summary. The derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniquely identifies each row and the zero duplicate_row_rate confirms no exact-duplicate rows need absorbing or aggregating.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The 3-letter NYC airport code (EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values) identifying which airport the observation belongs to, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the hourly weather observation, sampled at exact hour boundaries (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00) with null_rate 0.0, chosen as the event time column.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (samples 2013-01-01 through 2013-01-10, distinct_count 181), a dimension derived separately from the UTC time field, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour-of-day (0-23, distinct_count 24) of the observation, a labeling dimension rather than a summed quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (samples range 10.94 to 93.92 per operator context units), a continuous measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit (samples from -9.94 to 73.94), a measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage (samples 12.74 to 100.0, distinct_count 2178), a continuous measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in degrees (samples 0 to 360), a measured physical quantity; nullable with null_rate 0.016828, likely for calm-wind readings.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour (samples 0.0 to 1048.36058 per operator context units), a measured quantity; nullable with null_rate 0.000154.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour (samples 16.11092 to 62.14212), a measured quantity; nullable with high null_rate 0.745505 since gusts are not always recorded.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches (samples 0.0 to 1.06), a measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Barometric pressure in millibars (samples 983.8 to 1038.4), a measured quantity; nullable with null_rate 0.114953.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles (distinct_values 0.0 through 10.0, distinct_count 20), a measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: Full airport name (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport per distinct_values), a labeling dimension with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: Municipality of the airport (New York, Newark per distinct_values), a labeling dimension with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: Airport elevation in feet (distinct_values 13, 18, 21), a static attribute of the airport rather than a summed measure, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Longest runway length in feet at the airport (distinct_values 7002, 11000, 14511), a static attribute dimension with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Timestamp recording when the row was captured into the pipeline (samples 2026-09-02T23:26:11 to :13), a load-time attribute distinct from the observed event time, with null_rate 0.0.

category_description: Each row represents one hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA), joined with static OurAirports attributes for that airport, as declared complete per the operator context.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table enters the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, for consumption by the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models.
usage: The proposal is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before approval; only after approval does the modeling engine consume it to emit gold models.
limitations: The mapping does not filter, deduplicate, or otherwise alter rows beyond declaring the (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) identity; columns with substantial nullability such as wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505) and pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953) are passed through as nullable measures, and any decision to exclude or impute missing weather readings is left to downstream consumers.
